quest.title: Summer Vacation: Proceed With Caution
quest.description: Though these islands seem completely cut off from the rest of the world, they are somehow chock-full of hidden secrets and mysterious mechanisms. The party settles here for now and starts to get a taste of island life in the summer...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Wind-Blessed Harpastum x1, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh... The weather's so nice. Still feels like Paimon's dreaming.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good morning! Wh—Wha, what's with everyone's clothes!?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Hehe! So, how do we look?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: We changed into summer clothes! Although we didn't come here to have fun, we don't want to miss out on a beautiful summer day by the sea!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Th—This doesn't look weird, does it?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Such light and summery clothing definitely doesn't suit me... Ah, hehe... pardon me.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Really...? Thank you, Traveler.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's surprising that Master Jean would specially pack summer clothes.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Oh no, my big sister would never pack these herself. Lisa and I picked them out for her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Blurting out "big sister" and not even realizing it... Barbara's drunk on summer already!

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: There's quite a story behind these summer clothes...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I thought Lisa's pouch was to be used for an emergency. I didn't expect it to contain a set of summer clothing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All these accessories, too... Definitely Lisa's handiwork.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Everyone in the Knights of Favonius is always trying to have me take leave. I suppose I do push myself too much...
Everyone, come over here!

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: That's Klee's voice!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I saw something weird.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What's going on? What do you mean by something weird?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Look at the ocean!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: See? There's something weird floating on the water!

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: That narrow device... It seems to be a buoy.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: But we didn't see anything when we arrived here yesterday...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Dodo-King must have put them there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Strange devices that just appear overnight... Something doesn't add up.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Well, since he hasn't revealed himself to us, does that mean he's changed his mind? Or maybe...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Maybe these buoys are a clue and he's waiting for me to find him!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: So could that be why these buoys have suddenly appeared?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's take a closer look and find out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, we won't solve anything by guessing on-shore.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Is it okay to go out there though?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Perhaps, but we must investigate the buoys regardless.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: It's hard to say what will be waiting for us at sea. Just in case, prepare yourselves for combat.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Once you are ready, please assemble here, and we'll head over on the boat together.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: N—Not at all. This is... just my duty.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Now then, I'll entrust the preparation efforts to all of you.

choices.text: She's reliable even in summer wear.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: What could those buoys possibly mean...?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: These islands are isolated from the outside world, like a secret Domain crafted by nature itself.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: We were guided here by the letter and with the assistance of Venti and Dvalin... Everything seems a bit too serendipitous. I'm a little concerned.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: But I'm here to protect you all, so please don't worry. Come what may, I will face it head-on.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Ah... Su—Summer clothes, they're, uh... They were a surprise that Lisa prepared for me. My guess is that it was originally Barbara's suggestion.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Barbara said that it's so rare for us to get a chance to come to an island, we should change into summer clothing to set the atmosphere.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: However, I'm not used to this style of clothing. *sigh* I hope wearing this doesn't look too odd.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Have you finished your preparations?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: There is no need to rush. Take your time organizing your things. I will wait for you all here.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Great, then let's head to the <color=#00E1FFFF>boat</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Hmm? Is there anything I can do?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I just want to say that the ocean here is beautiful!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Sea and sun — a summer dream come true!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I really want to have a seaside performance! It would be amazing, I just know it!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: How do I look? Not bad, right?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I wanted to surprise everyone, so I specifically chose an outfit complementing an island atmosphere.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Oh, but please don't worry! Even if I'm wearing summer clothes, I'm still just as reliable in battle!

talks.objective: Talk to everyone about the changes to the island

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, what's going on here? This part of the ocean is way too mysterious!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: This whole stretch of land just rose out of the water!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Dodo-King, Dodo-King, I'm gonna catch you! Hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like Klee's as energetic as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Before the ground started shaking, I heard the sound of machinery. I believe there may be an immense mechanical structure under this region of the ocean.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: With the entire archipelago situated on a mechanical framework, it could be activated to raise each island from beneath the water.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Something like that would be nothing short of a miracle... Could it be the power of the Anemo Archon, Barbatos?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, probably not. Paimon feels like this is more likely a deliberate set-up...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It's incredible, no matter how you think of it. Using a letter to draw us here and these challenges involving various mechanisms... This so-called Dodo-King is no amateur.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I agree with Jean.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Aw, there goes the holiday mood...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Well, either way, I will do my best to remain vigilant.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! Master Jean's so cool when she's determined!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon and I will also exercise increased caution.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Thank you for your understanding.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I found him! It's Dodo-King!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: He's over on that island! Hee-hee, gotcha!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: You wanted Klee to come find you, so here Klee comes! Jumpy Dumpties, get ready~! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Is that... <color=#00E1FFFF>a platform in the middle of the ocean</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Something has appeared. Everyone, we can take a closer look, but please be on guard.

talks.objective: Check out the mysterious person before you

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Everyone, please be careful!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Is that a really tall person?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: It resembles a human, but something's not quite right.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Dodo-King, I see you! You can, uh, Arb... Arbi...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Arbitrate!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Right! You can arbitrate Klee!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! What is this kid saying!?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: She obviously doesn't understand what that word means...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hey, Dodo-King! Why are you ignoring me?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Is it because I took too long and made you angry? Then... I'm sorry!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Huh, and now she's apologizing? I didn't see that coming...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hello! Dodo-King!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: It looks like they're not interested in Klee at all.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It's some kind of humanoid machine. No response... It must be damaged.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, do you recognize it?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: No, I can only guess. It looks completely out of place on this island... Look at its clothes. It appears like it came from Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Inazuma? But isn't that really far away?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So this machine isn't from around here?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It would appear so. This area of the sea is independent and does not border any country, so it certainly seems out of place here.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: But given Inazuma's current situation, how could something like this occur...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: An abandoned machine... Weird! Did someone bring it here?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh no! Dodo-King isn't moving anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Klee, maybe Dodo-King is tired.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, right, Dodo-King is probably asleep. He was waiting so patiently for you and then *yawn* — nap time!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Let's go with Klee to play elsewhere and come back once Dodo-King wakes up.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Really?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Of course!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hm... No, I get it now!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: This isn't Dodo-King. The real Dodo-King is somewhere else.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Huh? I—Is that right?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I won't give up. Dodo-King, just wait! We'll find you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And there she goes again... Whew, she's got a lot of spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Klee, wait for us!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight, look here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's this?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Look at these stacked-up stones and small flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: It feels like a memorial for someone.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Hey, you're embarrassing me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But the only other thing around here is that machine in Inazuman clothing.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Could the memorial be for the machine?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Perhaps it once performed some deed that merited a memorial.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Everything we've seen here indicates that there was once a human presence in these waters. Still, there isn't enough for us to infer what kind of civilization it was.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: And up to now, we still have yet to see any people or gravestones.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Master Jean, can I go over there and have a look?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Yes, but be careful!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Okay!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How many secrets do these islands hold?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Klee is too young to have a proper sense of danger. Traveler, the rest of us must stay alert to the situation.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Honestly speaking, I thought that letter was only a prank at first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's what we thought.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I suspected as much too, but who would send a prank letter to a child?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: A letter that guides us to activate mechanisms on a deserted archipelago... It's bizarre.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: It makes me wonder whether this isn't some kind of trap, long in the making. We must keep our guard up.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Miss Barbara!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Klee, what's wrong?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Do you think that Dodo-King doesn't want to see Klee?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Why would the Dodo-King not want to see you, Klee?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Dodoco loves me, an—and I love Dodoco, so Dodo-King can never separate us. That's why Dodo-King doesn't want to see us...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: *whimper* Klee doesn't want him to separate us.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Hey Klee, do you know what this is?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: It's a harpastum!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I heard my big sis— Uh, Master Jean say that Klee always wanted to play harpastum, right?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah! Klee was just thinking about Ludi Harpastum!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I made this harpastum especially for you. Now every day can be Ludi Harpastum, hee-hee!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yay!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The kindness of a deaconess...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: So keep your chin up, Klee! After we meet Dodo-King, we can all help you convince him to let you and Dodoco stay together.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Okay!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's double our efforts. We have to find him.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Leave it to us Klee. This Dodo-jerk can't hide forever.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even if it takes a thousand years and a thousand searches... uh, w—we'll get him! Ahem...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But until then, let's have a good look around the area!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hmm, I need to bring Jumpy Dumpties, Dodoco, and... myself!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Dodo-King must have placed those things in the ocean! He's a bad guy!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: But I will bravely face him and do my best for Dodoco!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight, thank you for helping me.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I like summer! But not just summer.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I also like fall. Oh yes, and I also like spring and winter!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Even though winter's very cold, I have Jumpy Dumpty. Whenever I feel cold, I blow something up.
